# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-23 from the 2026-10-23 Hub dump.

- 3,177,706 models tracked, 903,174 declare a base model, 936,128 parent links, 88,890 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
